title: Bennie Boatwright earns Tim Cone’s praise after solid Gilas debut

blocks.text: LIVE: Gilas Pilipinas vs Syria – Fiba Asian Qualifiers 5th window MANILA, Philippines–Bennie Boatwright’s debut as a naturalized player for Gilas Pilipinas received a passing mark from coach Tim Cone, who believes things will eventually go smoothly once he gets comfortable with the system. Boatwright put up 16 points and 13 rebounds in almost 25 minutes on Friday as Gilas rolled past Syria, 97-58, in the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers at Karisma Arena in Seremban, Malaysia.
